results.explanation:
The disposition follows from the evidence. T-MM-02 is a registered market maker on SYN.A (profile). Cancel_symmetry is 0.954 and quote size is 328 against a typical 327. large_orders is empty and the largest order is 0.13x depth. opposite_side_fill_qty is 0 and price_move and round_trip are null. The 3378 same-side fills came before any opposite trade. That supports the market-making explanation and shows both core features absent, which meets the closure standard. Every number checked (8200, 2478, 0.954, 0.132, 3378, 0.2861, 8.57, 0.837, 1977 ms, 327, 15.9, 203/174/62, 2.69) appears in the tool results. Memory is treated as context only. Indicator vocabulary is good, with matched and unmatched indicators listed explicitly.

Weaknesses:
(1) The report never reconciles the detector's framing with the discriminators. The detector treats SELL as the spoof side and the BUY fills as opposite fills; the discriminators make BUY dominant, with opposite fills of 0. A reviewer sees 'no opposite-side execution' beside an alert citing BUY executions against SELL cancels. The report could have invoked the procedure's rule that the fill-sequence test has no meaning for two-sided quoting, but did not.
(2) The sequence is not laid out. The 10:21:11 burst of marketable 328-lot BUY orders lifting the 9998 offer, after which the touch moved to 9999/10001, is described only as 'fills on BUY quotes'.
(3) 'Paired quotes at 1-tick-wide offsets' is inaccurate: bid and offer sit about 4 ticks apart.
(4) Algorithmic re-pricing is marked 'undetermined' while citing E2 in ruled_out_by, which is internally inconsistent.

The core reasoning is sound and grounded, but clarity and explanation handling are weak in places.
results.label: Good
